desc: REBIRTH UPDATE LIVE! 🔥 Welcome to Forge Frontier – Silver, Proter, Frozy, Zoomy, Falco, Frost and Dave invite you to become the Forge Master! 🌌Embark on an immersive journey through distinct realms, from the mystical Castle of Blades to the spooky Shadow World.
